note: BIOS call table slot (NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS calls)

name: CHECKSUM_LOOP
note: wiki: calc a checksum and loop forever

name: FIX_CLEAR
note: BIOS call table slot (NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS calls)

note: BIOS call table slot (NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS calls)

note: BIOS call table slot (NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS calls)

name: CONTROLLER_SETUP
note: BIOS call table slot (NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS calls)

name: ScaleTableA
note: 64 rows x 64 bytes, each row starts at $40 and decreases; use not read in code yet

name: ScaleTableB
note: 64 rows x 64 bytes of ramps (row 0 = 0..63); use not read in code yet

name: AbsSineTable
note: 384 words |sin(n*pi/128)| * $10000, the peak stored as $0001; use not read in code yet

name: CheckSettingMode
note: reads hard DIP 1 (bit 0 of REG_DIPSW, 0 = on) and branches to TestModeEntry when it is on; MAME: setting mode DIP opens test mode

name: TestModeEntry
note: test mode start: clears system mode, RAM and both palette banks, sets up the BIOS RAM, then TestMenu

name: TestMenu
note: main menu: draws TestMenuText and the date, up/down moves the cursor, A selects (TestMenuSelect); MAME screen

name: TestMenuDrawCursor
note: erases the cursor at the old line, copies WorkIndexNew to WorkIndex, draws it at the new line

name: TestMenuCursorCmd
note: writes one MESS_OUT command for the cursor at line WorkIndex (VRAM $70E5 + 3 x line)

name: PutBcdByte
note: appends a MESS_OUT command printing a BCD byte as two digits at VRAM d2; a leading 0 stays blank

name: TestMenuText
note: MESS_OUT data: the 7 menu lines and the date frame

name: PutWeekday
note: appends the 3-letter name of BIOS_WEEKDAY from WeekdayNames

name: WeekdayNames
note: SUN MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT, 4 bytes each ($FF ends a name)

name: TestMenuSelect
note: pushes TestMenu as the return address and jumps to TestMenuJumpTable[WorkIndex]

name: TestMenuJumpTable
note: 7 entries in menu order: HardwareTest, TestHardDip, TestSoftDip, TestBookKeeping, TestCodeNumber, TestCalendar, TestMenuExit

name: TestMenuExit
note: EXIT: while hard DIP 1 is still on, shows "DIP-SW 1 OFF !!" and waits

name: TestHardDip
note: menu item: SETTING UP THE HARD DIP screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestSoftDip
note: menu item: SETTING UP THE CABINET (soft DIP) screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestBookKeeping
note: menu item: book keeping screen (CABINET/COIN, CABINET/PLAY); ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestCodeNumber
note: menu item: CODE NUMBER SETTING screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestCodeNumberCard
note: writes the code number to the memory card (texts CODE NUMBER HAS BEEN SET. / THIS CARD IS INVALID.); not run with a card

name: TestCalendar
note: menu item: SETTING UP THE CALENDAR screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: HardwareTest
note: menu item 1: clears RAM and palettes, then calls HwTestStepTable[WorkIndex] once per frame

name: HwTestStepTable
note: 14 entries: for each of the 7 screens a draw routine and a per-frame routine

name: HwTestCrosshatch
note: draws the crosshatch (palette and VRAM); MAME screen 1

name: HwTestCrosshatchFrame
note: per frame: START (bit 0 of ram_10FEDD) goes to step 2

name: HwTestColorBars
note: draws the RED GREEN BLUE WHITE bars; MAME screen 2

name: HwTestColorBarsFrame
note: per frame: START goes to step 4

name: HwTestIoCheck
note: draws the I/O CHECK screen; MAME screen 3

name: HwTestIoCheckFrame
note: per frame routine of the I/O check (inputs, DIPs, LED counters)

name: HwTestSound
note: draws the SOUND TEST screen; MAME screen 4

name: HwTestSoundFrame
note: per frame routine of the sound test

name: HwTestMemCard
note: draws the MEMORY CARD TEST screen; MAME screen 5

name: HwTestMemCardFrame
note: per frame routine of the memory card test (prints TEST OK / TEST ERROR)

name: HwTestBackupClear
note: draws the BACKUP CLEAR screen; MAME screen 6

name: HwTestBackupClearFrame
note: per frame routine of the backup clear (A+B+C)

name: HwTestCalendar
note: draws SETTING UP THE CALENDAR inside the hardware test; MAME screen 7

name: HwTestCalendarFrame
note: per frame routine of the hardware-test calendar

name: WaitFrame
note: sets FrameWaitFlag and loops until SystemInt1 (VBlank) clears it

name: Reset
note: target of the reset vector and ENTRY_RESET

name: SystemInt1
note: target of SYSTEM_INT1 (VBlank routine called by games)

name: SystemInt2
note: target of SYSTEM_INT2 (wiki: acknowledges hblank); never ran: none of Sengoku 2, NAM-1975, Cyber-Lip, Magician Lord points its level 2 vector at it

name: SystemReturn
note: target of SYSTEM_RETURN

name: SystemIo
note: target of SYSTEM_IO

name: CreditCheck
note: target of CREDIT_CHECK: MVS, free play off (hard DIP 7, bit 6 of REG_DIPSW): BCD check of the requested credits ($10FDB0) against Credits

name: CreditDown
note: target of CREDIT_DOWN (wiki); never ran. Referenced by Magician Lord (unused wrapper) and King of the Monsters 2 (after CREDIT_CHECK in a routine gated by a game flag, not reached by a P2 join); none of 10 other checked games

name: ReadCalendar
note: target of READ_CALENDAR

name: SetupCalendar
note: target of SETUP_CALENDAR (wiki); MAME: runs when D is pressed on the test-mode calendar screen

name: Card
note: target of CARD: returns $80 (no card) when REG_STATUS_B bits 4-5 are set, else jumps through CardFunctionTable[BIOS_CRDF]

name: CardError
note: target of CARD_ERROR (wiki); MAME with a blank (unformatted) card: runs when the game starts, after CardDataSearch

name: HowToPlay
note: target of HOW_TO_PLAY (wiki); MAME: NAM-1975 calls it after START (joystick and buttons animated, the game captions); not called by Sengoku 2, Cyber-Lip, Magician Lord

name: ChecksumLoop
note: target of the checksum slot at $C0047A

name: FixClear
note: target of FIX_CLEAR

name: LspFirst
note: target of LSP_1ST (clear sprites)

name: MessOut
note: target of MESS_OUT

name: ControllerSetup
note: target of CONTROLLER_SETUP

name: PowerOnTest
note: boot tests: LED latches, then work RAM, backup RAM, palette banks 1/0 and VRAM (test number in d6), calendar, system ROM checksum, memory card; errors go to BootError

name: WorkRamTestLoop
note: when REG_DIPSW reads 0 (all hard DIPs on): shows WORK RAM TEST and repeats the RAM tests until a DIP is turned off

name: BootErrorMemCard
note: d6 = 7 (MEMORY CARD ERROR), then BootError

name: BootErrorCalendar
note: d6 = 5 (CALENDAR ERROR) when VBlankCount between two calendar pulses is outside $39-$3F (57-63 frames, about 1 s), then BootError

name: WaitRtcPulse
note: waits for a rising edge of bit 6 of REG_STATUS_A (calendar pulse, wiki register page)

name: RtcCommand
note: sends the 4-bit command in d0 to the calendar chip, bit by bit through sub_C12DB0

name: MemTestBlock
note: memory test of d5+1 words from a0 (test number in d6), used for work RAM and palette banks

name: BackupRamTest
note: memory test of backup RAM at a0 (test number in d6)

name: ClearBackupRam
note: unlocks backup RAM and fills it with zeros from $D10000 down

name: VramTest
note: VRAM test through REG_VRAMRW, d4 start address, d5 count

name: Delay
note: nested BSR chain into sub_C18500: a fixed delay used between LED latch writes

name: BootError
note: error screen: message BootErrorMessages[d6]; for d6 < 5 also prints the failing address and data

name: BootErrorMessages
note: pointers to the boot error texts: 0 WORK RAM, 1 BACKUP RAM, 2 COLOR RAM BANK0, 3 COLOR RAM BANK1, 4 VIDEO RAM, 5 CALENDAR, 6 SYSTEM ROM, 7 MEMORY CARD

name: ClearRamAndVideo
note: clears work RAM, both palette banks, the fix layer (FixClear), sprite VRAM, then LspFirst

name: BiosStart
note: after the tests: MESS_OUT buffer, ControllerSetup, then SystemModeDispatch

name: SystemModeDispatch
note: resets the stack, then jumps through SystemModeTable by the low byte of BIOS_SYSTEM_MODE

name: SystemModeTable
note: 3 entries: SystemMode0, SystemMode1, SystemMode2

name: SystemMode0
note: mode 0: selects the slot (SelectSlot), loads the game soft DIPs (LoadGameSoftDips), then CallUser with request 0 (init)

name: SystemMode1
note: mode 1, eyecatcher: CART_EYECATCH_FLAG 0 runs the system ROM Eyecatcher, 1 calls the game (CallUser request 1), 2 skips to mode 2

name: SystemMode2
note: mode 2: shows SLOT n (SlotText, slot from $D00108) for up to 300 frames, ended early by bit 1 of ram_10FEDD; then CallUser with request 2 (demo), or 3 (title) when bram $D00034 is non-zero and $D00043 is 0

name: Eyecatcher
note: system ROM eyecatcher (NEO-GEO logo, MAX 330 MEGA, SNK), reached when CART_EYECATCH_FLAG is 0; MAME boot sequence

name: ReadControllers
note: selects the joystick ports through REG_POUTPUT, reads REG_P1CNT/REG_P2CNT/REG_STATUS_B and updates BIOS_P1STATUS and the following input bytes

name: MvsLedUpdate
note: MVS only: credit LED / marquee latch handling at the start of SystemIo

name: PlayTimeCount
note: MVS, while a game runs (BIOS_USER_MODE 2): every 60 frames adds 1 to a long in backup RAM ($D00048, through a4 = $D08000)

name: CallUser
note: hands over to the game: BIOS_USER_REQUEST = d0, BIOS_SYSTEM_MODE = d1 | $80, cartridge vectors (REG_SWPROM), backup RAM locked, jmp CART_USER

name: SlotText
note: MESS_OUT text "SLOT " used by SystemMode2

name: LoadGameSoftDips
note: copies the current game soft DIP block from backup RAM into BIOS_GAME_DIP (6 bytes, then 12 nibbles)

name: SelectSlot
note: scans the slot table in backup RAM ($D00124, 4 bytes per slot) from the slot in $D00109

name: CheckPlayerStart
note: SystemIo while a game runs: start buttons from BIOS_STATCHANGE set BIOS_START_FLAG; on the title with credits the BCD BIOS_SELECT_TIMER counts down and forces a start; calls CART_PLAYER_START, then mode 3

name: StartCreditCheck
note: MVS: checks the requested starts in BIOS_START_FLAG against the credits before CART_PLAYER_START

name: CardFunctionTable
note: 8 entries indexed by BIOS_CRDF (wiki CARD: 0 format, 1 data search, 2 load, 3 save, 4 delete, 5 read data title, 6 save user name, 7 load user name)

name: CardFormat
note: CARD function 0: format memory card (wiki); MAME: runs when the card utility formats a card (test build)

name: CardDataSearch
note: CARD function 1: data search (wiki); MAME with a blank card: called when the game starts

name: CardLoadData
note: CARD function 2: load data (wiki); MAME: Sengoku 2 LOAD prompt with a saved card, the game resumes in its second area

name: CardSaveData
note: CARD function 3: save data (wiki); MAME: Sengoku 2 SAVE prompt after losing in level 2, writes SENGOKU2 SAVE DATA

name: CardDeleteData
note: CARD function 4: delete data (wiki); MAME: card utility DELETE A DATA (test build), then THERE IS NO DATA.

name: CardReadTitle
note: CARD function 5: read data title (wiki); MAME with a card: runs at boot and in the hardware test

name: CardSaveUserName
note: CARD function 6: save user name (wiki); MAME (card utility test build): writes "AAA" at card offset $11 when END is chosen

name: CardLoadUserName
note: CARD function 7: load user name (wiki); MAME: runs when FILE USER'S NAME opens

name: DeductStartCredits
note: after CART_PLAYER_START: for P1 and P2 (DeductPlayerCredit) takes the credits and counts the start in book keeping; MAME: credits 02 -> 01 on START

name: DeductPlayerCredit
note: if the player's bit is set in BIOS_START_FLAG: unless free play (hard DIP 7) subtracts 1 from Credits in BCD (not below 0), then updates the book keeping counters

name: BookKeepingCount
note: adds to a book keeping counter at a2 (called for several counters per start)

name: CardLock
note: locks the memory card (REG_CRDLOCK1/2); pushed as the return address by Card, so it runs after every CARD call

name: ControllerTest
note: unreferenced in SP-S2 (no call, jump or pointer to it): draws CONTROLLER TEST and shows the P1/P2 input bits as 0/1 every frame

name: PutInputBits
note: appends 10 characters 0/1 for the low bits of d1 (ControllerTest)

name: ControllerTestText
note: MESS_OUT data of the controller test screen

name: CardUtility
note: unreferenced in SP-S2: MEMORY CARD UTILITY menu, up/down over 6 lines, A jumps through CardUtilityMenuTable

name: CardUtilityMenuTable
note: 6 entries in menu order: format, display data name, copy, delete, file user's name, END (Reset)

name: CardUtilFormat
note: menu item 1. CARD FORMAT; MAME (test build): FORMAT THE CARD screen

name: CardUtilDisplayNames
note: menu item 2. DISPLAY DATA NAME; MAME (test build, blank card): THERE IS NO DATA.

name: CardUtilCopy
note: menu item 3. COPY A DATA (table order)

name: CardUtilDelete
note: menu item 4. DELETE A DATA: lists the data, asks DO YOU MIND TO DELETE DATA, deletes through CARD function 4; MAME test build

name: CardUtilUserName
note: menu item 5. FILE USER'S NAME: character grid, A types, END saves through CARD function 6; MAME test build

name: CardUtilityMenuText
note: MESS_OUT data of the MEMORY CARD UTILITY menu

name: ClearFixLayer
note: resets the MESS_OUT buffer (BIOS_MESS_POINT = $10FF00) and fills the $500 fix-layer words from VRAM $7000 with $20 (space); kicks the watchdog (REG_DIPSW write) in the loop

name: PutHexByte
note: reads a byte at (a1)+ and appends it at (a0)+ as two hex characters

name: ByteToHex
note: d0 byte -> two ASCII hex digits (high in d0, low in d1)

name: NibbleToHex
note: d1 nibble -> ASCII '0'-'9' / 'A'-'F'

name: PutMenuValueLine
note: appends a MESS_OUT line at VRAM d2, highlighted when d6 equals WorkIndexNew, followed by the BCD value d0 (leading 0 as a space)

name: WaitFrameGetP1
note: WaitFrame, then returns P1 change bits in d0 (repeat bits in the high word); special handling when BIOS_P1STATUS is 3

name: CardUtilPutText
note: queues the MESS_OUT text at a2 followed by dat_C15CE0

name: ReadCardDetect
note: d0 = REG_STATUS_B & $30 (memory card detect bits, 0 = card inserted)

name: DivU32
note: unsigned 32-bit division: d4 / d3 -> quotient in d4, remainder in d0

name: CardUnlock
note: unlocks the memory card (REG_CRDUNLOCK1/2); counterpart of CardLock

name: WriteRtcCtrl
note: writes d1 to REG_RTCCTRL (calendar chip data/clock/strobe lines)

name: BcdToBinary
note: d0 BCD byte (00-99) -> binary through BcdToBinaryTable

name: BcdToBinaryTable
note: 256 bytes: binary value of each BCD byte, 0 for invalid digits

name: RtcSendByte
note: sends the 8 bits of d0 LSB first to the calendar chip through WriteRtcCtrl (data, clock high, clock low)

name: RtcReadByte
note: reads 8 bits from the calendar chip (bit 7 of REG_STATUS_A), LSB first, into d0; runs at every boot in MAME

name: RtcSendByteAlt
note: same protocol as RtcSendByte but through $280051 (cartridge area); never ran in MAME

name: RtcReadByteAlt
note: same protocol as RtcReadByte but reading $220001 (cartridge area); never ran in MAME

name: WriteRtcCtrlAlt
note: writes d1 to $280051, the alternate calendar control used by RtcSendByteAlt

name: FillVramWords
note: writes d0 to (a0) d1+1 times (REG_VRAMRW with auto-increment)

name: IsSnkRomCard
note: compares the card header with "SNK ROM " (dat_C144F0): detects a read-only SNK ROM card

name: SnkRomCardId
note: "SNK ROM " card header

name: SwitchSlot
note: after sub_C11FB2: slot d5 to CurrentSlot and REG_SLOT, then the cartridge fix layer (REG_CRTFIX) and vectors (REG_SWPROM)

name: WriteLedData
note: writes d5 (inverted) to REG_LEDDATA and pulses REG_LEDLATCHES ($F7 between two $FF), with Delay

name: LockBackupRamUnless
note: locks backup RAM (REG_SRAMLOCK) unless ram_10FEBF is set

name: RtcCommandAlt
note: 4-bit command through WriteRtcCtrlAlt, like RtcCommand on the alternate calendar path

name: PutBitChar
note: appends 0 if the Z flag is set on entry, else 1 (I/O check)

name: RtcClockPulse
note: pulses the calendar clock line: WriteRtcCtrl 2 then 0

name: ReadCalendarAlt
note: reads the date and time into BIOS_YEAR.. through the alternate calendar path ($280051/$220001)

name: SetupCalendarAlt
note: after sub_C12EF8 checks the date, writes BIOS_SECOND.. to the calendar through the alternate path; called by the hardware-test calendar ($C17CBE)

name: RtcClockPulseAlt
note: pulses the alternate calendar clock line: WriteRtcCtrlAlt 2 then 0

name: CheckCalendarDate
note: converts BIOS_YEAR/BIOS_MONTH.. from BCD and checks them against limits (dat_C12FEC); d7 non-zero when invalid; runs before SetupCalendar in MAME
